brands.description: Old Admiral is an Indian brandy from Radico Khaitan, launched in 2002. It is known for a rich taste and aromatic finish.
brands.story: Radico Khaitan introduced Old Admiral in 2002 as part of its Indian brandy range. The label remains a familiar choice for drinkers looking for a warm, aromatic brandy style.

tasting_notes.title: Aroma and style
tasting_notes.description: Rich brandy character with an aromatic finish.

tasting_notes.title: Character
tasting_notes.description: Warm fruit and gentle sweetness make it a natural fit for a relaxed after-dinner pour.

how_to_enjoy.description: Serve a measured pour in a small brandy glass, with water alongside.
Try it with tandoori chicken, seekh kebab, or dark chocolate.

brands.why_choose: A straightforward Indian brandy with a rich, aromatic style and an easy after-dinner serve.

faqs.question: What is Old Admiral?
faqs.answer: Old Admiral is an Indian brandy listed in Radico Khaitan's domestic portfolio.

faqs.question: How should I serve Old Admiral?
faqs.answer: Try a small pour in a brandy glass, with water alongside, or pair it with tandoori chicken and dark chocolate.

brands.final_verdict: Old Admiral is a warm, aromatic Indian brandy that works well neat, with water, or alongside rich grilled food.

brands.description: Vallonne Vineyards is an Indian boutique wine estate founded by Shailendra Pai in 2009 at Kavnai, Igatpuri, near Nashik.
